name: iIf
description:
Evaluates a Boolean conditional dynamic expression. Depending
on whether the expression is true or false, dynamically
evaluates one of two string expressions and returns the result.
syntax: iIf( boolean condition, string string_expression1, string string_expression2 )

params.name: condition
params.description: An expression that can be evaluated as a Boolean.

params.name: string_expression1
params.description: Expression to evaluate and return if condition is true.

params.name: string_expression2
params.description: Expression to evaluate and return if condition is false.
